newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Gulf tanker fire put out, four dead.
newsitem.headline: Danish Gulf tanker fire put out, four dead.

text.p: A fire aboard a Danish tanker off Iran which killed four Filipino crew was extinguished and the ship and cargo were out of danger, a spokesman of Copenhagen-based D/S Progress shipping company told Reuters on Friday.

"The fire has been put out and the tanker is in no danger. An investigation team has been sent out to the vessel and until the situation is assessed we do not know how long it will be out of action," the spokesman said.

He said that the 11,861 dwt Freja Nordic was now anchored off the Iranian Gulf port of Bandar Khomeini and that its cargo of 8-9,000 tonnes of refined oil products had not caught fire and no sea pollution had taken place.
The four Filipino crew members were killed by an explosion in the ship's engine room on Wednesday night, the Progress spokesman said.
